en: A vintage sepia-toned street view of an old European city labeled at the top with 'TRENTO' and 'Via Larga'. The scene shows a broad cobblestone street lined with multi-story historic buildings with arched windows and shutters. Horse-drawn carriages and several pedestrians in early 20th-century attire are visible along the street. The perspective looks down the length of Via Larga toward a distant building and tower.
